rationale: Coordinator calibration rule of 2026-09-28 23:15 UTC+8 (supersedes 22:30): CAL698 per-type temperatures are adopted only if they do not worsen aggregate calibration (Brier and ECE) on the development panels (typed DEV and CSS pilot), decided on development panels and never on formal ones; otherwise the model ships T = 1 and the card discloses the evaluated-and-rejected temperatures. The released DEV2.0-0.8B's CAL698 temperatures (Choice 1.123, Noul 1.071, Score 0.395) worsen typed-DEV Brier / ECE-10 from 0.269 / 0.128 (raw) to 0.300 / 0.180 (the CSS pilot improves only slightly: median task Brier-sum / ECE-15 0.834 / 0.127 to 0.821 / 0.109), so they fail the rule and DEV2.0-0.8B ships T = 1. Only probabilities change: the weights (identity 60356482) and every answer are identical, so post-key same-panel JevArena v3 50.236, the paired interval vs Decision 1.0 Eos (+7.69 [+3.65, +13.32]), public 231 156 and JevArena-C1 event 1 (40.24 vs Eos 1.0 37.94, +2.31 [+0.29, +4.30]) are unchanged, and the release gate still holds. On the card the formal typed Brier / ECE become 0.254 / 0.103 (CAL698: 0.278 / 0.150); formal calibration numbers were not a decision input.
